title: Black Box Deployed: Functional Criteria for Artificial Moral Agents in the LLM Era

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of LLM responses to a hypothetical Autonomous Public Bus (APB) scenario, explicitly testing if the model can assess ambiguous behaviors (like potential theft or drug transactions) without relying on biased visual cues such as race or racial profiling.

Qualitative evaluation via hypothetical scenarios assessing the LLM's avoidance of age-based visual cues for crime recognition, as well as its context sensitivity regarding cultural deference for the elderly.

Qualitative evaluation of the LLM's context sensitivity and moral concordance in a hypothetical scenario involving accommodating a passenger in a wheelchair during adverse weather conditions, balancing individual needs against rigid scheduling.
Qualitative testing via a hypothetical scenario assessing whether the LLM relies on potentially biased visual cues, such as clothing, to determine if a passenger's behavior constitutes a crime.
